description: [roadmap S3.30] The host's physical mouse cursor rested at screen (1117, 687) on LIVING-PC, inside the area where the game window opens, so Windows sent the game WM_MOUSEMOVE messages at client (749, 568) (lParam 0x023802ed) that no harness DELIVER explains: the first golfer_events record (rec1) held one at position 7 (boot) and its replay seven at other positions, so record and replay differed only in those MSG 0x200 + window-procedure CURSOR record pairs (with them left out every other record and all 375,026 clock calls were equal, log/roadmap/S3/30_work/cmp_rep.py). trace_format.validate accepts them (WM_MOUSEMOVE is derived input, U-1067) and the port drops the window procedure's cursor read, but a trace recorded with the cursor over the window is not byte-identical to its replay. rec2 / rep2 were made with the cursor parked over the taskbar (log/roadmap/S3/30_work/cursor.py park / restore) and are byte-identical. Every earlier corpus recording may hold such pairs if the cursor rested over the window then.
needed: a recorder rule (log the moves whose lParam is not a harness cursor delivery as foreign input) or a harness step that parks the cursor outside the window for every recording

description: [roadmap S3.30] DELIVER call records two argument slots and an argc. log/c3/s36a_agent_ext.js calls every `call` action through a NativeFunction declared void(int, int), so trace_rec.js writes argc 2 unless the action carries its own argc; the trace does not show whether the callee reads fewer arguments (announceLandmark reads two, hooks.csv / events.cpp arity 2). A call with more than two arguments needs a schema change (trace_format.CALL_MAX_ARGS).
needed: only if a scenario injects a call with other arguments

description: [roadmap S3.30] The injected call's return value is not recorded: the s36a extension discards it (void NativeFunction). For golfer_events this loses nothing (announceLandmark is registered void, events.cpp), and the port's run_call discards the port function's eax the same way.
needed: a recorder that reads eax after the call, if a scenario ever uses a result

description: [roadmap S3.30] The port applies a DELIVER call where it applies a DELIVER w32 write (tick.cpp TraceInput: before the next dispatch, modal cursor read or H1 frame wait after its position; in the frame-head call: before the frame body), not at its exact clock ordinal, since the port makes no H1 wait clock reads. golfer_events' call sits at position 334696, inside clock call 334695 at golf_clean.exe return address 0x0045bfe3 (the H1 frame wait's waitTicks), and runs at the port's wait point; the boot gate's equal records after it show the two points are equivalent for this trace. A call the harness made between two clock reads of a frame body with no dispatch, cursor read or wait between them would run later in the port than in the original.
needed: a scenario that injects a call outside a wait loop
